name: Kent Kentson Son Of Kent
source:
| LV: 58 | Berserker |

A peace-loving boy from the North, Kent is rarely seen without a smile or his companion, Foxy. He has a lot of respect for the peace keeping union, the Utopia Makers, and for his father, a powerful chief, but talking about both sometimes leave him strangely nervous.

(Taken from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31456"]Lemma Soft thread[/url])
